key_insight: TiRex-2 extends a recurrent xLSTM time-series foundation model from univariate to multivariate forecasting while supporting streaming inference with constant per-patch cost.
engineering_relevance: It offers a practical alternative to Transformer-based forecasters for real-time, long-context applications where joint variable modeling and low-latency updates matter.
method: Bidirectional time mixer for sequential context modeling under streaming.
Asymmetric grouped-attention variate mixer to incorporate future-known covariates without breaking causality on targets.
Synthetic coupling pipeline that builds multivariate training samples from large univariate corpora on the fly.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports state-of-the-art zero-shot results on GIFT-Eval and fev-bench, with stable behavior at arbitrary streamed context lengths and constant inference cost per patch.
watch_item: The multivariate design adds extra activated parameters, so deployment must account for memory/throughput tradeoffs and validate the synthetic coupling approach on target-domain data.
paper_title: TiRex-2: Generalizing TiRex to Multivariate Data and Streaming
